Subject: Solstice Bank IAM questionnaire (SB-IAM-2026)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our standard IAM questionnaire (Doc ID: SB-IAM-2026) — we need your responses and supporting evidence focused on SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM provisioning (user & group sync), RBAC/admin controls, and audit logging.

High-level asks:
- Confirm SAML 2.0 and OIDC support (IdP/SP flows you support).
- SCIM 2.0 support, attribute mapping and group sync behavior (do you support filtering/group-based provisioning?).
- RBAC model (built-in roles, ability to create custom roles, admin delegation).
- Evidence: SAML metadata, SCIM schema sample, screenshots or logs showing admin audit trails (PDF or ZIP ok).

Our procurement timeline is tight — can you get answers with attachments within 3 business days? If you need to redline anything or request exceptions, call that out.

Thanks,
James Park
Director, Security & Identity
Solstice Bank

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Solstice Bank IAM questionnaire (SB-IAM-2026) — draft answers

Tessa / team — draft answers below (summarized). I'll attach the full completed questionnaire and a SCIM mapping sample CSV in the package.

SAML / OIDC
- SAML: We support SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows). Service Provider metadata is available (attached SAML_Metadata.xml). Our SAML implementation supports standard NameID formats and attribute-mapping for email, firstName, lastName, and custom attributes.
- OIDC: We support OIDC Authorization Code flow (PKCE for public clients) and client credential flows for machine-to-machine. Dynamic client registration is supported on private deployments; hosted customers use keyed client registration via our Console.

SCIM
- We implement SCIM 2.0 (RFC7644) for user and group provisioning.
- Supported operations: POST /Users, PATCH /Users, GET /Users, POST /Groups, PATCH /Groups, bulk via PATCH for batch updates.
- Group sync: We support provisioning groups and assigning membership. Current hosted behavior: group membership sync is flat (no nested group expansion). We do support filtering on SCIM queries (e.g., filter=members.value eq "{{id}}") but do not currently support server-side LDAP-style complex filters for hosted accounts. Private deployments can enable custom group expansion hooks.
- Custom attribute mapping: supported through the Console and via SCIM schema extension -- see attached SCIM_Mapping_Sample.csv for common mappings (e.g., officeLocation -> location, department -> dept).

RBAC & Admin Controls
- Built-in role set: "viewer", "developer", "operator", "admin", "security_admin".
- Custom roles: Yes — tenants can create custom roles with fine-grained permissions across routes (generate, embed, admin).
- Delegated admin: Role-based delegation is supported. We also support temporary elevation tokens (time-limited) for emergency access; all elevations require justification stored in audit logs.

Audit, Logging & Retention
- Admin actions and role changes are logged with actor, IP, and timestamp. Logs are retained 13 months by default for Hosted; retention options vary with enterprise contract.
- Export: Logs can be streamed to customer S3 buckets or forwarded to SIEM via HTTP webhook / syslog connector (see evidence screenshots).

Known limitations / exceptions
- Nested group expansion: not supported in hosted product today (documented workaround: map nested groups in IdP with a flat group membership attribute, or use Private deployment hooks).
- SCIM complex server-side filtering: limited in hosted offering.

Attachments I'll prepare: SAML_Metadata.xml, SCIM_Mapping_Sample.csv, screenshots of audit log UI, and a redwood-iam-evidence.zip with sample logs and SOC2 pointer.

I'll send the completed questionnaire and attachments for review by EOD; happy to take point edits from Rishi on RBAC wording.

- Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: James Park <j.park@solsticebank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <s.liu@solsticebank.com>, procurementsolstice@solsticebank.com
Date: 2026-09-18T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Solstice Bank IAM questionnaire (SB-IAM-2026) — quick clarifications

Tessa / Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft. Two clarifications before you finalize:

1) SCIM filtering: when you say you support filtering (e.g., filter=members.value eq "id"), can you confirm whether the filter supports attribute normalization (case-insensitive match) and whether we can pass a custom attribute like msExchUserAccountControl? We need predictable behavior for AD-sourced attributes.

2) Group membership in SAML assertion: would you be able to produce a sample SAML assertion showing groups emitted as a claim (e.g., <Attribute Name="groups">)? If not, can you confirm whether we can map SCIM group membership into a custom SAML claim during SSO?

Also — please include your SAML metadata XML in the package. Procurement will want the metadata and an evidence ZIP for audit.

Thanks,
James
Director, Security & Identity
Solstice Bank

Subject: RE: Solstice Bank IAM questionnaire (SB-IAM-2026) — package attached

James — attaching the completed questionnaire and evidence bundle. Summary of the follow-ups you asked for:

- SCIM filtering: hosted SCIM supports case-insensitive equality for standard string attributes. For custom AD attributes (e.g., msExchUserAccountControl) we recommend normalizing in the source IdP or mapping through an attribute transform; private deployments can enable more complex server-side normalization. See SCIM_Mapping_Sample.csv for examples.

- SAML groups in assertion: we can emit a groups claim. Attached is a sample SAML assertion snippet and the SAML_Metadata.xml for Redwood's SP. If you need a signed assertion sample for testing, let us know and we can generate one under a test tenant.

Attached files:
- Solstice_IAM_Questionnaire_Answers.pdf (full answered questionnaire)
- SAML_Metadata.xml (SP metadata)
- SCIM_Mapping_Sample.csv (sample attribute mappings and examples)
- redwood-iam-evidence.zip (audit screenshots, sample logs, SOC2 pointer)
